hook: If you stood on Uranus, daylight could last 42 years.
title: On Uranus, one day can last 42 years
description:
Uranus is tilted about 98 degrees, so it rolls around the Sun like a ball. Its rings and moons circle it vertically, and each pole gets years of non-stop sunlight. Part of the If You Were in Space series.

#Shorts #Uranus #IfYouWereInSpace

scenes.narration: If you stood on Uranus, daylight could last 42 years.
scenes.headline: 42 Years Of Daylight

scenes.narration: The planet is tilted about 98 degrees.
scenes.headline: Tilted 98 Degrees

scenes.narration: So it rolls around the Sun like a ball.
scenes.headline: It Rolls Like A Ball

scenes.narration: Its rings stand upright, like a wheel.
scenes.headline: Rings Stand Upright

scenes.narration: Its moons circle it vertically too.
scenes.headline: Moons Go Vertical

scenes.narration: One pole faces the Sun, then the other.
scenes.headline: Poles Take Turns

scenes.narration: One lap around the Sun takes 84 years.
scenes.headline: One Year = 84 Years

scenes.narration: Uranus is a planet lying on its side.
scenes.headline: Lying On Its Side

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: a blue sunset on Mars.
